description: Create a new arm profile. Only available when using local alarm manager.

requestBody.name: automations
requestBody.description: List of automation IDs associated with this arm profile.

children.name: start
children.description: Cron expression for the start time.

children.name: end
children.description: Cron expression for the end time.

requestBody.name: recordEverything
requestBody.description: Whether to record everything when this arm profile is active.

requestBody.name: activationDelay
requestBody.description: Activation delay in milliseconds. Allowed values: 0 (none), 60000 (1 min), 300000 (5 min), 600000 (10 min).

fields.name: automations
fields.description: List of automation IDs associated with this arm profile.

children.name: start
children.description: Cron expression for the start time.

children.name: end
children.description: Cron expression for the end time.

fields.name: recordEverything
fields.description: Whether to record everything when this arm profile is active.

fields.name: activationDelay
fields.description: Activation delay in milliseconds. Allowed values: 0 (none), 60000 (1 min), 300000 (5 min), 600000 (10 min).

local.ansible:
- name: Create arm profile
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/arm-profiles"
    method: POST
    body:
      name: string
      automations:
        - string
      schedules:
        - start: string
          end: string
      recordEverything: true
      activationDelay: 0
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data

remote.ansible:
- name: Create arm profile
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/arm-profiles"
    method: POST
    body:
      name: string
      automations:
        - string
      schedules:
        - start: string
          end: string
      recordEverything: true
      activationDelay: 0
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
